name: app-red-black-crypto-risk-and-wallet-screens-collage
title: Red and Black Crypto Risk Screens
whatItIs: A three-tile board: a phone on a ribbed black plinth with a red gradient backdrop showing a portfolio risk score with donut gauges, a red wallet chart tile with striped bars, and a black tile of coin transaction cards.
whatItMeans: Red signals risk and energy, and repeating vertical stripe textures gives a cohesive, technical texture across data tiles.
techniques: Striped bar backgrounds as chart texture
Donut gauges with a bright red arc for risk
Single red hue across backdrop, UI and chart
Ribbed plinth echoing the stripe motif
Paired coin icons per transaction card

vocabulary.definition: A donut or bar showing a risk percentage.
Repeated thin lines used as pattern or bars.
A tile showing a single payment with icon and amount.
